The '''Dust Vipers''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group operating out of the [[Dust Viper Den]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="DND" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Year">{{TOR_updates|5}}</ref> the Dust Vipers stole data from an [[Eternal Alliance]] patrol. As a result, the Alliance's [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] [[Destruction of the Dust Vipers|attacked]] their base, retrieved the data and destroyed them.<ref name="DND" />
